title: handoff adopt refuses outside a fresh-session boundary
action: Doctrine: planned-next handoff adoption fires only at a fresh-session boundary; resumed or compacted sessions never adopt. Make it mechanical: (a) find where session-init writes/updates the session record (search hooks/ for session record writes; the SessionStart hook receives source startup|resume|clear|compact) and persist that source on the session record if not already there; (b) in handoff adopt (workflow_store/handoff.rs), refuse when the calling session's recorded source is resume or compact, naming the pause-presentation fallback as the remedy; a missing source (older records) warns and proceeds. If session records live in a file other than session_init.rs expects, follow the actual write site - adjust your file list in the outcome line if you had to touch a different hook file (stay within hooks/ + workflow_store/). D7 red-first: source-persistence test and source-classification test before the refusal; then adopt tests (fresh startup -> adopts; resume -> refuses pinned message; compact -> refuses; absent source -> warn + proceed).

trace.outcome: Session records persist start source; adopt refuses on resume/compact with pause fallback named; missing source warns and proceeds; worktree runs: workflow_store 38, session_init 17, all green
